mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.student_code, s.name, s.gender, s.age, s.class_name, s.disability_type, s.remark FROM app_user_student aus JOIN student s ON s.id = aus.student_id WHERE aus.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id, s.student_code, s.name, s.gender, s.age, s.class_name, s.disability_type, s.remark FROM app_user_current_student current_student JOIN student s ON s.id = current_student.student_id WHERE current_student.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user_current_student (user_id, student_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{studentId}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_id = new.student_id
